service.en: Attestation of school certificate (private foreign-curriculum schools)
service.ar: تصديق شهادة دراسية للتعليم العام داخل الدولة

about: Have a general education certificate from a private foreign-curriculum school in the UAE attested.
note: Requirements read from the official MOE service page on the checked date. MOE fills the form in after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Attestation of school certificate (private foreign-curriculum schools). Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Certificates from private schools licensed by MOE that follow a foreign curriculum
Schools in Abu Dhabi, Dubai, Sharjah and Ras Al Khaimah are attested by their own education authority
documents: Copy of the certificate to be attested, in PDF
fees: Optional digital MOFA attestation: AED 150 plus AED 150 for the UAE embassy abroad
channels: MOE website or smart app, sign in with UAE PASS
